dataformat.name: mimeMultipart
dataformat.title: MIME Multipart
dataformat.description: Marshal Camel messages with attachments into MIME-Multipart messages and back
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation

marshalIn.description: The body of the first part, of the content type in the Content-Type header (application/octet-stream when not set); the attachments of the message are the other parts

marshalOut.description: The MIME multipart in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off, with its MIME headers as Camel headers unless headersInline is true. Without attachments the body is written as it is, unless multipartWithoutAttachment or headersInline is true

unmarshalIn.description: A MIME multipart, with its Content-Type (multipart/*) and MIME-Version as Camel headers, as marshal leaves them; with headersInline, the MIME headers are at the start of the body

unmarshalOut.description: The first part, decoded, as a stream, with the other parts as attachments and its Content-Type as a header. A body that is not a multipart stays as it was: without headersInline, one without a multipart Content-Type header

multipartSubType.description: Specify the subtype of the MIME Multipart.

multipartWithoutAttachment.description: Whether a message without attachment is also marshaled into a MIME Multipart (with only one body part).

headersInline.description: Whether the MIME-Multipart headers are part of the message body (true) or are set as Camel headers (false).

includeHeaders.description: A regex that defines which Camel headers are also included as MIME headers into the MIME multipart. This only works if headersInline is set to true.

binaryContent.description: Whether the content of binary parts in the MIME multipart is binary (true) or Base-64 encoded (false).
